The '''snack munch bubble''' was a popular [[Gungan/Legends|Gungan]] fast-food restaurant that offered various crunchy foods, such as [[nyork]] meat wrapped in [[nave]] leaves, [[chuba-pie]]s, [[chuba chips]], and [[adder moss chips]].
